title: Disentanglement in the macroscopic limit
summary: The recently proposed spontaneous disentanglement hypothesis is formulated using a modified Schrödinger equation having an added nonlinear term. The hypothesis is motivated by some outstanding issues in the foundations of quantum mechanics, including the problem of quantum measurement. Spontaneous disentanglement is explored in the current study for the macroscopic limit. This is done using some many--body models having known exact solutions.
